}}'''Graeger''' was a farmer. He was married to [[Alysa]]; his two sons and wife survives.

==History==
The incident that killed Graeger may have been a [[Bubble of evil]]. "''The man had walked around a corner over in [[Negin Bridge]] and vanished. ''

When people went looking, all they found was a twisted, leafless tree with a gray-white trunk that smelled of sulfur.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Graeger}} The [[Dragon's Fang]] had been scrawled on a few doors that night''."{{ref/book|13|1}}''

== Trivia ==
* Graeger is named for Alfred Granger, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
